info.name: Channel Connect - WhatsApp Starter
info.description: Send the hello_world starter template through the local application. One-time setup: set outboundLocalAuthToken to OUTBOUND_LOCAL_AUTH_TOKEN (not the Meta access token). Run with the local profile and include the recipient in OUTBOUND_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS and hello_world in OUTBOUND_ALLOWED_TEMPLATES. The application uses WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN from its own configuration. Set recipient to an international number containing digits only, without + or spaces. The hello_world template in en_US must be available for the configured WhatsApp account. 202 means accepted by Meta, not delivered. No requests are sent automatically. Each Send creates a new submission unless idempotencyKey is explicitly set; set and reuse that key when retrying the same message.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('outboundLocalAuthToken')) throw new Error('Set outboundLocalAuthToken to OUTBOUND_LOCAL_AUTH_TOKEN.');
if (!/^[1-9]\d{7,14}$/.test(pm.variables.get('recipient') || '')) throw new Error('Set recipient to an international number: 8-15 digits, no + or spaces.');
pm.test('Starter accepted by provider', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });
if (pm.response.code === 202) { pm.test('Provider message identifier returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().providerMessageId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; }); }
